resources.string: Swarm sharing
SWARM
Share your records with named people, revocably, with no server in the middle. Off by default; reads only, and never writes to the loop.
Your invite
Show the code someone scans to start following you

Show this to someone who should be able to follow you. It is not a secret: it holds a public key and an address, and anyone who has it can download your data and read none of it. They still cannot open anything until you add their key below.
Nothing to share yet. Turn Swarm sharing on and wait for the first records to be sealed — an invite needs both your key and somewhere to reach you.
Copy
Your name
Shown to people who follow you, instead of a row of letters and numbers. It travels in your invite and goes no further \u2014 it is never published.
How much history to share
Applies to the next person you share with. It does not change what anyone already has.
Share with someone
Paste the key they gave you. They will be able to read as much history as the setting above allows.
Stop sharing with
Paste their key. They stop getting anything new, lose today, and keep every day that had already finished.
Who can read
The people you have shared with
Can read your whole history
How much they can read was not recorded — this share is older than the setting
To stop sharing with someone, copy their key above and paste it into “Stop sharing with”.

Stopping takes effect at once. They get nothing new, and today goes back out of reach as well — but every day that had already finished stays readable to them, and nothing can change that. The keys are on their phone and the sealed records are spread across other people\'s phones. If that matters, share a smaller window next time.
Nobody. Use “Share with someone” to add a key.
Scan a code
Point the camera at someone else\'s invite
Point at their invite code
That is a QR code, but not a Swarm invite. Ask them to open Swarm sharing → Your invite and show you that code.

What should this do?

FOLLOW THEM keeps a copy of their history. You will not be able to read any of it until they share with you.

SHARE WITH THEM lets that key read yours, as “%2$s”.

%1$.1f mg/dL, %2$d min ago
Held, but not readable — they have not shared with you yet.
Nothing has arrived from them yet.
Follow someone by invite
Paste an invite they sent you. Following costs them nothing; you cannot read anything until they share with you.
Shadow the new vault (experimental)
Also seal into the new vault, read it back, and log whether every record survived. Nothing reads it; the existing vault stays in charge.
Re-read everything from the database
Forget how far the drain got and seal the whole history again. Safe to repeat; takes a while.

This re-reads every record AAPS holds and seals it again. Nothing in the AAPS database is changed, and sealing the same record twice does nothing — but it will take several minutes and use battery.\n\nGo ahead?
